title: Synonyms and confusable words 2
about: Verbs that are easy to mix up: gain, win, earn, make, achieve and beat (you win a match but beat a team), then take, carry, wear and use, and spend for both time and money.

parts.title: Verbs connected with gaining, winning and achieving
Other words that are often confused
Common mistakes
parts.note: Spend працює і з часом, і з грошима: провести тиждень — spend a week, витратити гроші на щось — spend money on sth. Pass, stay і use тут зазвичай не підходять. Після spend + час ставимо дієслово з -ing: spend an hour cooking.

items.pattern: gain power · gain control (of sth) · opposite: lose power / control
items.meaning: get authority, or the ability to decide what happens in a place or situation
items.uk: прийти до влади; взяти під контроль
items.example: The new teacher soon **gained control** of the noisy class.
more: In the fairy tale, the wicked queen **gains power** by tricking the old king.
The young referee never really **gained control** of the match.
items.watchOut: Після control зазвичай стоїть of (іноді over), не on: gain control of the situation. «Прийти до влади» — come to power або gain power, без the.

items.pattern: gain / get access (to sth) [formal]
items.meaning: manage to get into a place, or get the right to use something
items.example: Visitors can only **gain access** to the roof garden with a guide.
more: You need a code to **gain access** to the building after 10 p.m.
Fans tried to **gain access** to the stadium without tickets.
items.watchOut: «Доступ ДО чогось» — access TO sth, не access for / at. Access тут без артикля: gain access, не gain an access.

items.pattern: gain / earn a reputation (as sb / for sth) · a good / bad reputation
items.meaning: become known for something, good or bad
items.example: The little café soon **gained a reputation** for its amazing breakfasts.
more: My uncle **earned a reputation** as a terrible driver after three accidents in one year.
The hotel has **gained a bad reputation** because of the noise.
items.watchOut: «Репутація хорошого лікаря» — a reputation AS a good doctor; «славиться чимось» — a reputation FOR sth, не reputation of. Earn a reputation теж природно. Fame (слава) — незлічуване: не a fame.

items.pattern: gain / win / receive recognition (for sth)
items.meaning: get public praise and respect for what you have done
items.example: After years of hard work, the young chef finally **gained recognition** for her cooking.
more: The volunteers **gained recognition** for helping families after the flood.
His photos of the city at night **gained recognition** in a national magazine.
items.watchOut: Recognition тут — «визнання», не «впізнавання». Без a: gain recognition, не a recognition. Так само кажуть win / receive recognition.

items.pattern: gain / get / attract publicity · a lot of / bad publicity
items.meaning: get attention from newspapers, TV and the public
items.example: The school's charity run **gained publicity** in all the local papers.
more: The new park **gained** a lot of **publicity** when a famous actor opened it.
The hotel **gained** some bad **publicity** after a TV programme about dirty kitchens.
items.watchOut: Publicity — не «публічність», а увага ЗМІ, реклама, розголос. Незлічуване: a lot of publicity, без a.

items.pattern: gain / get / have an advantage (over sb)
items.meaning: get something that makes you more likely to succeed than other people
items.example: By getting to the shop early, she **gained an advantage** over the other bargain hunters.
more: Speaking two languages can help you **gain an advantage** when you look for a job.
The home team **gained an early advantage** with a goal in the first minute.
items.watchOut: Перевага НАД кимось — an advantage OVER sb, не before / above. Не плутай з take advantage of sth — «скористатися чимось».

items.pattern: win a prize / an award / a medal / a trophy · win first prize · win £500 (in a competition)
items.meaning: get a prize, medal, etc. because you did best in a competition
items.example: My sister **won a prize** for the best photo in the school competition.
more: He **won a silver medal** at the swimming championship.
Our street **won an award** for the prettiest gardens in town.
items.watchOut: «Вибороти / завоювати медаль» — win a medal: conquer тут не кажуть, а gain звучить неприродно. Перший приз — win first prize, зазвичай без артикля; «посісти перше місце» — come first. Гроші виграють (win) у конкурсі чи лотереї, а за роботу заробляють (earn).

items.pattern: win / lose a match / a game / a race · win 3–1 · win (on Saturday)
items.meaning: be the winner of a game or a sports competition
items.example: Our team **won the match** in the last minute.
more: Did you **win your tennis match** this morning?
She **won the race** easily, ten metres ahead of the others.
items.watchOut: Win — про гру, матч, перегони: We won the match. Суперника — beat: We beat their team. Не «we won them» і не «we won the team».

items.pattern: win / lose a battle / a war · win the battle against sth
items.meaning: be successful in a fight; also used about any long, hard struggle
items.uk: виграти битву / війну, перемогти в боротьбі
items.example: After three weeks, we've finally **won the battle** against the ants in the kitchen.
more: Nobody really **wins a war**. Everyone loses something.
My mum is slowly **winning the battle** against the weeds in her garden.
items.watchOut: «Перемогти у війні / в битві» — win a war / a battle, без in. Ворога перемагають інакше: defeat / beat the enemy.

items.pattern: win / lose an election · win by 40 votes
items.meaning: get the most votes and be chosen
items.example: She **won the election** and became the first woman mayor of our town.
more: "If we **win the election**, we'll build a new sports centre," the candidate promised.
Nobody expected the young teacher to **win the election**.
items.watchOut: «Перемогти НА виборах» — зазвичай просто win an election, без on / in. Суперника на виборах — beat / defeat sb.

items.pattern: earn a (good / decent / high) salary · earn £2,000 a month
items.meaning: get a regular amount of money for your job
items.example: Doctors in this country **earn a good salary**.
more: She **earns** twice as much as her husband.
When I started work, I **earned a tiny salary**.
items.watchOut: Salary — фіксована зарплата службовця; у Британії її зазвичай називають за рік (a salary of £30,000 a year), а платять щомісяця; wage(s) — погодинна чи тижнева оплата. «Отримувати зарплату» — earn / get a salary. Не win a salary: win — тільки в змаганні чи лотереї.

items.pattern: earn money (by working) · make money (from sth / by doing sth)
items.meaning: get money by working; with make, it can also be by selling or investing
items.example: She **earns good money** as a hairdresser.
more: You can **make money** by selling your old clothes online.
My grandparents **made** a lot of **money** from their small shop.
items.watchOut: «Заробляти гроші» — earn або make money. Win money — виграти (у лотерею, на конкурсі). Gain money англійці майже не кажуть. Робити гроші — make money, не do money.

items.pattern: make a profit / a loss (on sth) · make a profit of £500
items.meaning: get more (or less) money from selling something than it cost
items.example: The bakery **made a profit** for the first time this year.
more: The cinema **made a loss** three years in a row.
You won't **make a profit** if you sell your cakes so cheaply.
items.watchOut: «Отримати прибуток» — make a profit, а не do і зазвичай не get a profit. Протилежне — make a loss (не make a minus). Прибуток НА чомусь — a profit ON sth.

items.pattern: achieve (great) success (in / with sth)
items.meaning: do very well and get the result you wanted
items.example: My cousin **achieved success** as a fashion designer before she was thirty.
more: Not everyone **achieves success** on their first try.
Their little restaurant **achieved great success** in its first year.
items.watchOut: «Досягти успіху» — achieve success, без a і без прийменника. Не make success. «Робити успіхи» (у навчанні) — make progress.

items.pattern: achieve / reach your goal(s) · achieve your aim(s) · achieve an ambition / a dream
items.meaning: do what you planned or hoped to do
items.example: She **achieved her goal** of losing five kilos before the wedding.
more: Small steps every day help you **achieve your goals**.
The school **achieved its aim** of raising money for a new playground.
items.watchOut: «Досягти мети» — achieve / reach your goal, без прийменника: не achieve to the goal. «Здійснити мрію» — achieve / realise your ambition / dream, не do your ambition.

items.pattern: beat / defeat a team / an opponent · beat sb at chess / tennis · beat sb 3–1 · defeat is more formal
items.meaning: do better than someone in a game, race or fight
items.example: I always **beat** my brother at table tennis.
more: It's hard to **beat** an opponent who never gives up.
Our little village team was **defeated** 5–0, but everyone had fun.
items.watchOut: «Виграти в когось» — beat sb, не win sb: I beat him at chess (не I won him). Win — тільки гру чи приз: I won the game. Beat — beat — beaten.

items.pattern: take sth (with you) (to a place) · take an umbrella / warm clothes
items.meaning: have something with you when you go somewhere, for example pack it for a trip
items.example: **Take** a raincoat **with you**. It always rains in Manchester.
more: We **took** far too many clothes to Spain and never wore half of them.
I always **take** a book when I go to the dentist's.
items.watchOut: Речі, які кладеш у валізу чи сумку перед поїздкою, — take (with you). Carry — нести в руках або носити при собі весь час, тому «взяти теплий одяг у поїздку» — take warm clothes, не carry. Bring — коли річ несуть СЮДИ, до того, хто говорить: Bring your guitar to my party!

items.pattern: (always) carry sth (with you / in your bag / in your pocket)
items.meaning: have something with you all the time, in a bag or pocket
items.uk: носити з собою, мати при собі
items.example: I always **carry** a few plasters in my bag.
more: Do you **carry** your ID card **with you**?
My grandad still **carries** a photo of my gran in his wallet.
items.watchOut: Українське «носити» — це і wear, і carry. На собі (одяг, окуляри, годинник) — wear; з собою в сумці чи кишені — carry. Не «I always wear my phone».

items.pattern: carry a bag / a box / a baby · carry sth up / down / home
items.meaning: hold something in your hands or arms and move with it
items.example: Can you **carry** this bag? My arms are tired.
more: She was **carrying** a baby in one arm and a bag of apples in the other.
We had to **carry** the piano up three flights of stairs.
items.watchOut: «Нести» — carry. Сумку в руках теж carry: She always carries a big bag. Про рюкзак на спині кажуть і wear a backpack, але покупки, валізу, коробку — тільки carry.

items.pattern: wear clothes / a dress / a suit / jeans / a uniform · be wearing sth
items.meaning: have clothes on your body
items.example: My brother **wore** a tie for the first time at his graduation.
more: On Sundays I **wear** old jeans and do nothing.
She's **wearing** a lovely green dress today.
items.watchOut: «Одягнути» (дія) — put on; «бути вдягненим, носити» (стан) — wear: Put on your coat! / She's wearing a coat. Після dress одяг не ставлять: get dressed, be dressed in red, а не dress a dress. Вимова wear /weə/ — як where, не як we're.

items.pattern: wear a hat / glasses / a watch / a ring / make-up / perfume
items.meaning: have something on your head, face or body, not only clothes
items.uk: бути в капелюсі, носити окуляри (годинник, прикраси)
items.example: My dad **wears glasses** only for reading.
more: She never **wears** make-up to the office.
Why are you **wearing** sunglasses? It's raining!
items.watchOut: Окуляри, годинник, каблучку, макіяж і навіть парфуми англійці теж wear: wear glasses, wear perfume. Carry a hat — нести капелюх у руці, а не бути в ньому.

items.pattern: use a laptop / a phone / an umbrella / a map · use sth for sth / to do sth
items.meaning: do something with an object for a purpose
items.example: My mum **uses** her laptop mainly for video calls with us.
more: We **used** a paper map because there was no signal in the mountains.
Nobody **uses** an umbrella here. The wind just breaks it.
items.watchOut: «Користуватися чимось» — use sth: use a phone. Але «користуватися популярністю / повагою» — enjoy popularity / respect, не use. Дієслово use вимовляється /juːz/, іменник a use — /juːs/. Позичити на хвилинку — Can I use your pen?

items.pattern: spend a week / the weekend / your holiday (in / at a place) · spend time (with sb)
items.meaning: be somewhere, or with someone, for a period of time
items.example: We **spent** the weekend at my parents' house in the village.
more: Where are you **spending** Christmas this year?
How long are you **spending** in Paris?
items.watchOut: «Провести час» — spend time. Pass the time — це «згаяти час», щоб не нудьгувати (We played cards to pass the time), а з тижнем чи відпусткою так зазвичай не кажуть. Conduct і hold — «проводити» збори, уроки, дослідження, не час.

items.pattern: spend money / £50 on sth · spend a lot / too much (on sth)
items.meaning: use money to buy or pay for something
items.example: My brother **spends** all his **money on** concert tickets.
more: Don't **spend** all your pocket money **on** sweets!
We **spent** a fortune **on** the wedding.
items.watchOut: «Витрачати гроші НА щось» — spend money ON sth, не use money і зазвичай не spend for. А «платити ЗА щось» — pay FOR sth.

items.pattern: spend an hour / two days / ages doing sth · spend time on sth
items.meaning: use a period of time for an activity
items.example: My son **spends** hours **drawing** comics in his room.
more: We **spent** two days **painting** the bedroom.
Don't **spend** too long **getting** ready, the taxi's coming!
items.watchOut: Після spend + час — дієслово з -ing: spend an hour cooking, не to cook. Не stay two hours watching TV: «просидів дві години перед телевізором» — spent two hours watching TV.

warmup.uk: Тато ніколи не обігрує мене в теніс.
warmup.explain: Виграти в когось — beat sb. Win — тільки гру чи приз: he won the game.
Вибороти медаль, виграти приз — win a medal / a prize. Conquer тут не кажуть, а beat — тільки про суперника.

warmup.q: How much do you ___ a month?
warmup.explain: Заробляти — earn (або make). Win — виграти в лотерею чи на конкурсі.

warmup.uk: Я хотів би проводити більше часу з батьками.
warmup.q: I'd like to ___ more time with my parents.
warmup.explain: Проводити час — spend time. Pass the time — «згаяти час»; conduct — проводити дослідження чи урок.

warmup.uk: На сонці вона завжди ходить у капелюсі, щоб захистити обличчя.
warmup.q: She always ___ a hat in the sun to protect her face.
warmup.explain: Носити на собі (одяг, капелюх, окуляри) — wear. Carry — нести в руці або мати при собі в сумці.
Досягти мети — achieve / reach your goal, без прийменника.

warmup.q: Last year the café ___ a profit.
warmup.explain: Отримати прибуток — make a profit; зазнати збитків — make a loss.

warmup.uk: Ми витрачаємо забагато грошей на каву.
warmup.q: We ___ too much money on coffee.
warmup.explain: Витрачати гроші на щось — spend money on sth.

A.q: We ___ the champions 2–1 in the final!
A.explain: Суперника перемагають — beat / defeat sb. Win — тільки гру, фінал чи приз: we won the final.

A.q: My cousin ___ a good salary as an electrician.
A.explain: Зарплату заробляють — earn a salary. Win — у змаганні чи лотереї.

A.q: My aunt gained a ___ as the best cook in the family.
A.explain: Здобути репутацію когось — gain a reputation as sb. Fame і recognition незлічувані, з a їх не вживають.

B.q: At the party she was ___ a long red dress and gold earrings.
B.explain: Бути в сукні, носити сережки — wear. Carry — нести в руках; dress не ставлять перед одягом.

B.q: It's a long walk to the station. Shall I ___ your suitcase for you?
Can I ___ your pen for a second? I need to sign this form.
B.explain: Скористатися чимось — use sth, без прийменника.

M.q: My brother ___ a year in Canada after university.
M.explain: Провести рік десь — spend a year somewhere. Conduct і hold — проводити збори чи дослідження, не час.

M.q: How much money did you spend ___ presents this Christmas?
M.explain: Витрачати гроші НА щось — spend money ON sth.

M.q: Yesterday I spent two hours ___ for a birthday present for my mum.
M.explain: Після spend + час — дієслово з -ing: spend two hours looking.

topics: packing for a trip to the mountains

example.title: Gran's big year
example.uk:
У сімдесят років моя бабуся нарешті здійснила мрію всього життя: взяла участь у національному конкурсі пекарів. На загальний подив, вона перемогла сорок молодших пекарів і виграла перший приз за свій яблучний пиріг.

Завдяки місцевій газеті ця історія отримала великий розголос, і невдовзі люди вже стояли в черзі, щоб купити її пироги. Вона почала продавати їх на суботньому ринку і вже за перший місяць отримала двісті фунтів прибутку.

Усі ці гроші до копійки вона витратила на поїздку до Рима. Вона взяла з собою валізу, повну літніх суконь, і провела там тиждень: носила величезний солом'яний капелюх і за допомогою нового телефону зробила сотні фотографій. «Я не втомилася, — сказала вона мені. — Я тільки починаю».
example.en:
At seventy, my gran finally [[achieved her lifelong ambition|a15]]: she took part in a national baking competition. To everyone's surprise, she [[beat|a16]] forty younger bakers and [[won first prize|a7]] for her apple cake.

The story [[gained a lot of publicity|a5]] in the local paper, and soon people were queuing to buy her cakes. She started selling them at the Saturday market, and in the first month she [[made a profit|a13]] of two hundred pounds.

She [[spent|m2]] every penny on a trip to Rome. She [[took|b1]] a suitcase full of summer dresses and [[spent a week|m1]] there, [[wearing|b5]] a huge straw hat and [[using|b6]] her new phone to take hundreds of photos. "I'm not tired," she told me. "I'm just getting started."
